crfit.help: Charge-response parametrization of a molecule with xtpdft: the charge-response matrix Pi (Hirshfeld charges), the molecular polarizability and the residual polarizabilities, from the static response to Hirshfeld-localized potentials and uniform fields (coupled-perturbed Kohn-Sham, or finite differences of SCFs). Reads job_name.xyz; closed-shell molecules.

job_name.help: Input file name without extension, also used for intermediate files

method.help: analytic: coupled-perturbed Kohn-Sham (LDA, GGA, global hybrids); finite_differences: two SCFs per perturbation

tolerance.help: analytic: relative residual of the coupled-perturbed equations

step.help: finite_differences: strength of each perturbation: Hirshfeld-localized potential in Hartree, uniform field in Hartree/bohr

scf_error.help: Every SCF is converged to at least this DIIS error (and 1/100 of it in the energy): the ground state for both methods, and the perturbed SCFs, whose densities are differenced, for finite_differences

inversion.help: If the geometry has an inversion centre (equivalent atoms within 1e-4 bohr), perturb only one atom of each pair and obtain the other response by symmetry

mpsfile.help: Template .mps of the molecule with the permanent multipoles (same atoms in the same order); if given, output.mps is written with the residual polarizabilities on its P lines, rotated into the template frame

output.help: Output prefix: output.crm, output.json (the keys of xtp_cr_fit, readable by xtp_cr_mps) and, with mpsfile, output.mps
